reconstruction_policy: All source bytes, grids, dt and native horizons unchanged. Explicit cost profiles and the validated Channel actuator-clock repair are preserved. Formal evaluator bindings and full 39-case replay remain pending.

costing.original_hour_cases: Retain hour_release.estimate(record,4000): rate=max(old control rate, measured PPO seconds/controls); base=4000*rate+measured fixed pilot overhead; planning=1.25*base.
costing.unmeasured_allowances: For short-probe-only cases, two full episode replays are rate extrapolations, 300 seconds is an assumed fixed learner/checkpoint allowance, and 25% is planning reserve. Neither is an observed overhead nor a confidence bound. Actual costs can exceed these estimates.
costing.hardware_note: Two-H100 costs remain two-H100 wall times; GPU-hours multiply by two only for resource accounting, not as a single-GPU timing prediction.
costing.effective_learning_acceptance: 4,000 controls are a first reference experiment (~20 native MAIA episodes, 40 Channel episodes, ~6 nozzle episodes, 4 Kolmogorov episodes), not proof of informative learning or sample efficiency on every task.
costing.future_acceptance: Before promoting this to an active validated benchmark, run same-profile full-episode baselines/checkpoint replay and real training with intermediate learning curves. Do not silently shorten physics or drop difficult selected cases to pass.
